title: Causal-Aware Tabular GANs with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2510.24046v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing tabular data generation methods primarily focus on matching statistical distributions between real and synthetic data, often overlooking the preservation of underlying causal relationships. As a result, generated samples may appear realistic while failing to maintain the causal structure required for reliable downstream analysis. We propose CA-GAN, a causal-aware generative framework for tabular data synthesis that explicitly incorporates causal knowledge into both the training and generation processes. CA-GAN first extracts a causal graph from real data to provide structural prior knowledge, then employs a graph-conditioned Conditional WGAN-GP whose sub-generators model variables according to their causal dependencies. translated_title: 基于强化学习的因果感知表格生成对抗网络
translated_abstract: 现有的表格数据生成方法主要关注匹配真实数据与合成数据之间的统计分布，往往忽略了对潜在因果关系的保留。因此，生成的样本可能看起来逼真，却无法维持可靠下游分析所需的因果结构。我们提出了CA-GAN，一个用于表格数据合成的因果感知生成框架，它在训练和生成过程中均显式地融入了因果知识。CA-GAN首先从真实数据中提取因果图以提供结构先验知识，然后采用图条件化的条件WGAN-GP，其子生成器根据变量的因果依赖关系对各变量进行建模。更重要的是，我们引入了一种基于强化学习的目标函数，将真实数据与合成数据之间的因果图差异作为奖励信号，使因果一致性成为一个可优化的目标……
tldr: 提出CA-GAN框架，通过因果图结构先验和基于强化学习的因果差异奖励信号，将因果一致性显式纳入表格数据生成的训练过程，确保合成数据保留真实数据的因果关系。
